selection_principles: Separate final-answer correctness from reasoning-style supervision.
Prefer verifiable math, code, and structured tasks for RLVR.
Do not claim target-language reasoning transfer until native prompts and answers are independently checked.

mixing_guidance: Use verified final answers as the primary quality signal and treat visible traces as an ablated technique.
Cap reasoning-token inflation and retain ordinary instruction replay.
Run English-first baselines before adding target-language traces so transfer effects are attributable.
